verdict.rationale: Lambda documents workspace firewall rules that control incoming traffic to instances, including 1-Click Cluster head nodes, which implies instances can be reached and ports managed for serving. Inter-node connectivity is evidenced only inside 1-Click Clusters and managed Kubernetes (InfiniBand/GPUDirect RDMA up to 3200 Gb/s), not as general private networking between on-demand instances. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure/inbound-rule documentation for serving apps, private networking/VPC between standalone on-demand instances, independent or hands-on corroboration.
